caption:
Costa Rica’s oldest mountain trails were carved by hand, following the natural contours of the ridges to avoid the deep valleys below. When mountain biking in Costa Rica, you quickly learn that the shortest distance between two points is rarely a straight line. The climbs are steep, the air is thick with the scent of wet earth, and the grass-covered ridges offer brief, quiet moments to look out over the canopy before the next descent. There are no engines here, no traffic, and no hurry. Just the rhythm of your own breathing and the gravel road winding into the clouds. Send this to the friend who'd ride it with you.
